confidence_notes: Cairo price indexes near July support the meal, cappuccino and draft beer estimates. [Cairo restaurant prices](https://www.averagecostof.living/in/egypt/cairo-egypt/restaurants/) Cocktail and wine estimates use their typical price premium over local beer, with wider variation across venues. [Cairo bar price ranges](https://lorenzigo.com/best-bars-pubs-cairo-egypt/) Lodging prices are modeled estimates for July and vary by neighborhood and room quality.
comparable_city_reasoning: The lodging estimates reflect Cairo’s downtown budget accommodation supply and assume typical July demand during the hot summer season.
